top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff files reviewed did not have the required Health and Safety training topic certificates for the last full year of training.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months (26 TAC §746.1305(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infant room teacher was observed to not have pre-service training available  for review within caregiver record. The hire date was observed as 10/7/25.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguishers were last serviced in August of 2020.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Posts Marked to Proper Depth (26 TAC §746.4907(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Post in the swing play area are not marked to show the proper loose fill depth.    Post in the play scape area are not marked to show the proper loose fill depth.
